purpose: Sanitized citation-display cases; this fixture contains no private research output or chat content.

cases.prompt: A comparison reports a numerical difference in function between two named programs.
A safety conclusion could change whether a reader considers an intervention.
The answer draws a reasonable synthesis that the inspected source did not test directly.
A synthesis depends materially on findings from two independent sources.
A transition restates the answer structure without adding a decision-important factual claim.
Three distinct claims rely on different sources placed together at the end of one paragraph.
Only an adjacent source was found for an important claim.
